claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows several small used engines/motors wrapped in plastic with visible cylinder heads/engine blocks and some hoses/wiring; make/model/engine code (2ZR) and any gearbox details are not readable or confirmed.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/gearbox match (e.g., not actually 2ZR or not compatible with Corolla 2010), which can make the set unusable or require extra parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/label on the engine block (2ZR) plus gearbox code/label and matching VIN/fitment reference if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown used small engines/motors with unknown compatibility and no confirmed gearbox matching.

risks.risk: Not complete units (missing starter, alternator, ECU, wiring harness, carburetor/injectors, sensors, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Inventory video/clip showing each engine fully laid out with all major components present (starter, alternator, alternator bracket, ECU, harness, intake/exhaust connections) and what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/parts-only or missing accessories risk.

risks.risk: Non-working condition (seized, low compression, bad head/gaskets, electrical faults).
risks.proof: Start-test video (engine cranking and running) or compression test results screenshot/clip for each unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Hidden damage (cracks in head/block, stripped threads, bent shafts, broken mounts) not visible in the current wide photo.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of cylinder head/block surfaces, mounting points, and any visible cracks/repairs for each unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible damage not yet verified.

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (exact number of engines/units not confirmed).
risks.proof: Count-confirmation clip showing all units in one frame from start to finish, with a clear tally.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively per worst-case quantity/assortment uncertainty.

risks.risk: Fuel type/displacement unknown (petrol vs diesel; different displacements), affecting value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of engine identification plate and/or visible fuel system components (injectors/carb) plus displacement markings if present.

risks.risk: No documentation/serial verification (ownership/engine number mismatch), increasing fraud/return risk.
risks.proof: Photo of engine serial/engine number stamping and any receipt/ownership document; clear serial match to claimed model.

proof_requests: Provide clear close-up photos of the engine code/label showing 2ZR (engine block) and gearbox code/label.
Show an itemized list of what is included with each unit (starter, alternator, ECU, wiring harness, injectors/carb, sensors, mounting brackets).
Send a start-test video for at least one unit (crank + running) or compression test results for each.
Upload high-resolution close-ups of head/block and mounting points to check for cracks/repairs/stripped parts.
Confirm exact quantity with a single continuous clip counting all engines/motors.
response.reason: The witness confirms multiple used small engines/motors, but the key details needed to price a specific Toyota 2ZR Corolla engine + gearbox (exact engine/gearbox identity, completeness, and working condition) are not verifiable from the report. Without those proof points, any price would be too speculative.
